findings.title: Full-study error separation and resource controls are not calibrated
findings.nextTask: Preregister paired dt refinements for space studies, paired mesh refinements for time studies, tightened-solver endpoint comparisons, quadrature/projection checks, actual convergence reasons and normalized true residuals. findings.orderUncertaintyRelation: For refinement ratio2 and relative error uncertainty beta in[0,1), two-level order uncertainty is bounded by log((1+beta)/(1-beta))/log(2).
findings.resourceWarning: A 512x256 dense float64 system matrix alone is128GiB before factorization; keep dense oracle tiny. Sparse runtime and full-study wall time remain unmeasured. Freeze a separate resource budget.
findings.laterTimeIntegrator: PETSc ARK requires mass-matrix/boundary-stage verification. TSROSW's documented autonomous-system restriction prevents a direct substitution for this time-dependent source without verified reformulation.
